name: Steady-state and dynamic process simulation
principle: Software represents a plant as unit operations joined by streams and solves the mass and energy balances to find a stable operating point. Steady-state models ignore time; dynamic models add accumulation terms and so can be used for operator training, control design and troubleshooting.

process_steps.name: Define feed stream: composition, flow, pressure, temperature
Choose property models or vapour-liquid equilibrium data
Specify unit operations and connect streams
Read product stream properties, duties and costs

advantages: One model supports design, optimisation, training and control work
limitations: Result quality depends on the property data and reaction models chosen
Dynamic models need more calculation time and are mathematically more complex
